source.name: International football results from 1872 to present
source.author: martj42

elo.method: World Football Elo (eloratings.net): K 60 global finals, 50 continental finals, 40 qualifiers and nations leagues, 30 other cups, 20 friendlies; goal-difference multiplier 1, 1.5, (11+N)/8; home edge +100; start 1500

wdlFit.form: P(win)=1/(1+exp(-(a*d/100-c))), P(loss)=1/(1+exp(-(-a*d/100-c))), draw=rest; d=Elo gap incl. home edge

gameState.note: matches since 1990 whose goal list matches the final score (goalless games are not in the goal file, so they are excluded); close = Elo gap under 150
